changes.place: P21-D1; small isolated curve left of the main sketch
changes.ink: The oblique mark contains separated segments and unequal darkness, including a thicker middle patch. The first smooth curve flattened these visible gaps and weights. Adopt the segmented trace, without inferring an arrowhead or label.

changes.place: P21-D2; left edge of the main sketch
changes.h: a tetrahedral sketch, without stroke-level reproduction
changes.ink: The same four vertices and six edges occur in both readings. The crop additionally shows short partial retracings along the doubled left edge, unequal transverse dashes, and distinct small endpoint gaps. The revised paths follow these visible details; no edge or arrow direction is inferred.

changes.place: P21-D3; small sketch at upper right
changes.c: four-sided outline, two solid interior diagonals, one heavy straight oblique stroke and one dashed stroke
changes.h: a small polyhedral sketch traversed by an axis
changes.ink: The right outline has a visible gap, the center contains superposed dark strokes, and several ends broaden into tapered black patches. Reproduce those patches literally rather than calling them arrows. The pale oblique continuation belongs to the long ray already drawn elsewhere on the page, so its overlapping segment is not duplicated. Stroke order and intentional direction remain unresolved.

changes.place: P21-N20; bottom-left number
changes.ink: The first digit has an arched top, a descending stroke and a broad curved foot; the second is a separate closed oval. The two dark normal-facing digits read 20.
